answer_card.title: junipernetworks.junos changes in Ansible 10
answer_card.answer_md: junipernetworks.junos requires ansible-core 2.14+, removes previously deprecated modules (see Removed Features), and uses netcommon 6.1.0 for `cli_restore`.
